def: Money is what people use to buy things.
happened: You used coins to buy bread.
history: People used shells, salt, and coins.
ko: 돈: 사람들이 서로 바꾸기로 약속한 것

def: Money works when people believe in it.
happened: People trust your coins. Your coins are strong.
history: People trusted coins from Rome for a long time.

def: Prices go up. Your money buys less.
happened: You made lots of money. Bread costs more now.
history: Rome put less silver in its coins. Prices went up.
ko: 인플레이션: 물가가 오르고 돈의 가치가 떨어짐

def: Prices go up very, very fast.
happened: Bread cost a little. Now it costs a lot!
history: Long ago, one land made too much paper money.

def: Prices go down. People wait to buy. Shops sell less.
happened: There are not enough coins. Shops are empty.
history: Joseon did not have enough coins.
ko: 디플레이션: 물가가 내려가고 사람들이 물건을 안 삼
talk: Why is it bad when people wait to buy?

def: Prices go up, but jobs go down. Two bad things at once.
happened: Goods stopped coming. Bread costs more. Jobs are gone.
history: America had this about 50 years ago.
talk: What two bad things came together?

def: The price you pay to borrow money.
happened: You changed it. Now people borrow more or less.
history: Banks change it to help the land.
ko: 금리: 돈을 빌릴 때 내는 값
talk: Who borrows less when interest is high?

def: How much one money costs in other money.
happened: Your money trades for ATI COIN.
ko: 환율: 한 나라 돈을 다른 돈으로 바꾸는 비율
talk: What makes your money worth more?

def: The bank that makes a land's money.
happened: You are the bank. You decide.
talk: What does a central bank decide?

quiz.q: What does a central bank do?
